source:
Title: Acme Gateway flaw exploited
Summary: CVE-2026-1111 in Acme Gateway 7.4.2 let attackers run code. About 4,000 servers were exposed. Acme disclosed it on Nov 12 and patched it in 7.4.3. Rated 9.8. A scam campaign tricked 70% of targets and stole $2.3 million in 2026.
narration:
Acme Gateway had a serious flaw this week.

Attackers could run code on about four thousand servers.

Patch it today and check your logs.
